title: xbwl-world-heavyweight-xbwl
label: Legacy

won.source: A newsgroup title-change report, 6 October 1999: Legacy defeated Matt "Da Mac" Austin, self-billed as his fifth reign with the title.

note: Billed as Legacy's fifth reign; the promotion's own four prior reigns are not otherwise documented in the held record.

title: xbwl-north-american-xbwl
label: SuperCat

won.source: Wins a Four Corners, Elimination, Flaming Tables match for the vacant title with help from El Camero and El Dorito; the broadcast calls him "the first man to win a title in the new XBWL."

note: Any reign(s) between Chris Calhoun's own 9 October 1999 title billing (r001) and this one are not attested here; the broadcast's own words treat the title as starting fresh with the reopened promotion.

title: xbwl-world-heavyweight-xbwl
label: Brandon Thornton

won.source: Billed as reigning XBWL World Heavyweight Champion entering the promotion's 18 November 2001 reopening broadcast; no title-change document survives here.

end.source: New owner Sandra Lewis strips Thornton of the title moments before his match with Michael Andrews.

note: Any reign(s) between Legacy's own documented 6 October 1999 title win (r001) and this one are not attested here.

title: xbwl-north-american-xbwl
label: Chris Calhoun

won.source: The champion's own newsgroup roleplay post, 9 October 1999, self-billing as "your XBWL NA Champ."

note: Recorded from the champion's own billing; no title-change document survives in the held record.
